wwo.name: Singapore

road_validity.basis: 1890 guide map used for a candidate opening-date reconstruction. No replacement of raster fallback.

wwo.method: 1890 guide-map alignment; selected street skeleton and water/open-ground exclusions. Parcels and all buildings reconstructed in sourced use polygons. Outside the polygons and in source gaps, no inference of absence. Revised lower river and Tanjong Pagar harbour layout from the 1893 city atlas, with mapped work sheds and separate wet/dry coverage.

registration.method: local affine to stable landmarks; modern map used solely for locating controls
registration.control_reference: Singapore Land Authority OneMap Original, local viewing only
registration.reference_pixels: OneMap z15 relative to top-left XYZ 25835/16264 at 512 px/tile; approximate

sources.record: D’Aranjo, B. E., The Stranger’s Guide to Singapore, plate / British Library 10055.c.4, scan page 43
sources.licence: Public domain historical map and British Library reproduction
sources.precision: Guide map; separately registered. Nine inlier controls, leave-one-out 118 m RMS, max 174 m. Centre lines and outlines are schematic.

sources.licence: Referential narrative only, no figures or current conservation boundary reproduced
sources.date: Historical district accounts and present conservation descriptions

sources.licence: Referential narrative only, no assets copied
sources.precision: Two to three storeys, party-wall row, covered five-foot way; individual layouts and heights are inferred

sources.licence: Referential narrative only, no assets copied
sources.precision: Bridges located for registration, not part of candidate road network

sources.licence: Referential narrative only, no images copied
sources.date: 1890s Tanjong Pagar illustration and harbour history
sources.precision: Differentiated river warehouses and docks; building location/dimensions are inferred

sources.record: John G. Bartholomew, Edinburgh Geographical Institute, Constable’s Hand Atlas of India, plate 60, 1893, Boston Public Library copy
sources.licence: Public domain map, Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0
sources.precision: Local tracing from a 1280 px facsimile; control residuals in shore_registration. Atlas symbols and dimensions are approximate, especially west of the town controls.

shore_registration.limits: Controls surround the lower river; Tanjong Pagar is an extrapolation. Coast and shed outlines are traced from the atlas, with positional uncertainty. Tanjong Pagar Land Co. property limit did not establish dry land.
